summary: Truncation with an ellipsis, count-aware pluralisation, and camelCase to Title Case.
overview: Three string jobs that come up in every UI and get written slightly wrong each time. Truncate keeps the ellipsis inside the length budget rather than adding to it; Pluralize picks the word from the count; CamelToTitleCase splits on case boundaries, so it works on any identifier without a lookup table.
useCases: Fitting an item or quest name into a fixed-width label.
Writing "1 coin" / "2 coins" without a conditional at every call site.
Turning a serialized field or enum name into a readable label in a debug or editor UI.

gotchas.title: Pluralize only handles the regular +s case
gotchas.body: "enemy" would become "enemys". Pass the plural explicitly for irregular words: Pluralize(2, "enemy", "enemies").

gotchas.title: Truncate counts the suffix inside maxLength
gotchas.body: The result never exceeds maxLength, so the visible text is shorter than you might expect for a short budget with a long suffix.
